title: What JARVIS is
caption: A local bench assistant for board-level repair.
It runs on this Mac only, at 127.0.0.1.
It opens in Google Chrome.
say: JARVIS is a bench assistant for board-level repair. It runs on this Mac only, and it opens in Google Chrome.

title: Why it helps
caption: It answers from your own repair docs.
Every answer cites the line it came from.
If the docs don't cover it, it says so.
say: It answers from your own repair docs. Every answer links to the line it came from. If the docs don't cover a question, it says so instead of guessing.

title: Starting it
caption: Run: sh jarvis.sh
Chrome opens at 127.0.0.1:8765.
If the brain is offline, quick log, scanning and photos still work.
say: To start it, run sh jarvis.sh from the repo root. Chrome opens by itself. If the brain shows as offline, quick log, scanning and photos still work.

title: Start of shift: scan the board
caption: Scan the board serial, or press Alt+B.
JARVIS switches to that board.
Each entry is tied to one board.
say: Start the shift by scanning the board serial, or press Alt plus B. JARVIS switches to that board, and every entry you make is tied to it.

title: Log readings
caption: Alt+3 opens the bench log.
Type a test point and its reading.
Out-of-range readings are flagged.
Alt+Z undoes the last entry.
say: Press Alt plus 3 for the bench log. Type a test point and its reading. A reading outside its reference range is flagged right away. Alt plus Z undoes the last entry.

title: Seen before
caption: Alt+2: Seen before.
Verified patterns come first.
Then a keyword search over past cases and logs.
Then a brain pass that groups the matches.
say: Press Alt plus 2 for Seen before. Verified patterns come first, then a keyword search over past cases and logs, then a brain pass that groups the matches.

title: Ask, with a citation
caption: Alt+1: Ask the docs.
Answers come in labelled sections.
Each citation opens the source line.
Anything not in the docs is marked as general knowledge.
say: Press Alt plus 1 to ask the docs. Answers come in labelled sections. Each citation opens the exact source line. Anything that is not in your docs is marked as general knowledge.

title: Close-out card
caption: On the Board view, choose Close out.
JARVIS drafts the card from the log.
Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
say: On the Board view, choose Close out. JARVIS drafts the card from the log. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.

title: End-of-shift debrief
caption: Alt+4: the debrief.
A Slack update, Jira notes, open items and photos.
Copy only. JARVIS never sends anything.
say: Press Alt plus 4 for the debrief. It gives you a Slack update, Jira notes, open items and photos. You copy the text yourself. JARVIS never sends anything.

title: Weekly review
caption: Alt+7: the weekly review.
Counts of boards, questions and debriefs.
Top causes and recurring patterns.
say: Press Alt plus 7 for the weekly review. It shows the week's counts, the top causes and the recurring patterns.

title: Health
caption: Alt+8: Health.
Backup status and weekly usage.
A doc audit that reports stale links and never edits anything.
say: Press Alt plus 8 for Health. It shows your backup status, weekly usage, and a doc audit. The audit reports stale links, and it never edits your docs.

title: Backup
caption: Run: sh jarvis.sh backup
Pick a folder outside the repo, once.
JARVIS keeps the 10 newest backups.
say: Run sh jarvis.sh backup to copy your bench data. Pick a folder outside the repo once. JARVIS keeps the ten newest backups.

title: Why you can trust it
caption: Citations point to the source line.
"Not in docs" is said plainly.
Run sh jarvis.sh eval: 20 golden questions against the real brain.
say: You can check its answers. Citations point to the source line. When the docs don't cover a question, it says so. And sh jarvis eval runs twenty golden questions against the real brain, so you can see whether it still gets them right.

title: Shortcuts
caption: Alt+1 Ask   Alt+2 Seen before   Alt+3 Log
Alt+4 Debrief   Alt+5 Board   Alt+6 Patterns
Alt+7 Weekly review   Alt+8 Health
Alt+B Switch board   Alt+N New question
Alt+Z Undo last entry   / Quick log
Enter Save or send   Esc Close or stop
say: Here are the shortcuts. Alt plus 1 is Ask. Alt plus 2 is Seen before. Alt plus 3 is Log. Alt plus 4 is Debrief. Alt plus 5 is Board. Alt plus 6 is Patterns. Alt plus 7 is the weekly review. Alt plus 8 is Health. Alt plus B switches board. Alt plus N starts a new question. Alt plus Z undoes the last entry. Slash opens quick log. Enter saves or sends. Escape closes or stops.
